title: Server-side shop with input validation
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a Shop class for the server. `Shop.new(prices: {[string]: number})`.
`:buy(player: Player, itemId: any): (boolean, string)`. The player's coins are the player attribute "Coins" (a
number). A purchase succeeds only if itemId is a string that is a key of prices, the player does not own it yet and
has enough coins; then the price is subtracted from "Coins", the attribute "Owns_" .. itemId is set to true, and it
returns true, "ok". Otherwise nothing changes and it returns false and a short reason. itemId comes from a client,
so it can be any value.
